name: Kansas

flag.description: A dark blue field with the state seal in the centre, a sunflower on a twisted blue and gold bar above it, and KANSAS in gold letters below.
flag.symbolism: The seal shows a settler ploughing, a wagon train and bison under a rising sun, with 34 stars because Kansas was the 34th state.

hook: Kansas is the seal-on-blue with a sunflower perched on top and KANSAS in gold underneath.
trivia: The seal's motto "Ad astra per aspera" means "To the stars through difficulties".
The flag was adopted in 1927; the word KANSAS was added in 1961.
